name: Scenario F - Compliance Expiry Guard
description: Daily scheduled scenario that checks all ACTIVE contractors for certification expiry. Updates compliance_status and next_expiry_date fields on each contractor record, and sends alerts for EXPIRING_SOON and EXPIRED contractors to property managers via Scenario C.

scheduling.description: Runs every morning at 07:00 UK time to check contractor compliance before the working day begins.

modules.name: Trigger - Daily Schedule
modules.description: Daily trigger at 07:00 Europe/London. Initiates the compliance check sweep.

modules.name: Load Active Contractors
modules.description: Fetch all ACTIVE contractors with their certification expiry fields.

error_handler.note: If Airtable lookup fails, route to error handler

modules.name: Iterator - Per Contractor
modules.description: Iterate over each active contractor to evaluate compliance individually.

modules.name: Evaluate Compliance Status
modules.description: For each contractor, evaluate all certification expiry dates against today. Determine compliance_status (COMPLIANT, EXPIRING_SOON, EXPIRED, NOT_VERIFIED) and the next_expiry_date.

mappings.gas_safe_expiring_soon: {{if(contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry != '' AND contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry >= formatDate(now, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry <= formatDate(addDays(now, 30), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), true, false)}}
mappings.niceic_expiring_soon: {{if(contractor.fields.niceic_expiry != '' AND contractor.fields.niceic_expiry >= formatDate(now, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND contractor.fields.niceic_expiry <= formatDate(addDays(now, 30), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), true, false)}}
mappings.next_expiry_date: {{if(has_any_expiry = false, '', if(contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry != '' AND contractor.fields.niceic_expiry != '', if(contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry < contractor.fields.niceic_expiry, contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry, contractor.fields.niceic_expiry), ifempty(contractor.fields.gas_safe_expiry, contractor.fields.niceic_expiry)))}}

modules.name: Update Contractor Compliance Fields
modules.description: Persist the computed compliance_status and next_expiry_date back to the Contractors table.

error_handler.note: Log but continue if individual contractor update fails

modules.name: Filter - Needs Alert
modules.description: Only continue to alerting for contractors that are EXPIRED or EXPIRING_SOON.

modules.name: Send Compliance Alert via Scenario C
modules.description: Send a compliance alert to the property manager(s) via Scenario C outbound notifications. EXPIRED alerts are HIGH severity; EXPIRING_SOON alerts are MEDIUM severity.

message.text: {{if(compliance_eval.compliance_status = 'EXPIRED', '🚫 COMPLIANCE ALERT: ' + contractor.fields.company_name + ' has EXPIRED certifications: ' + compliance_eval.expired_certs_text + '. This contractor is now BLOCKED from new job assignments. Please request updated documentation immediately.', '⚠️ COMPLIANCE WARNING: ' + contractor.fields.company_name + ' has certifications expiring within 30 days: ' + compliance_eval.expiring_certs_text + '. Please request renewed documents before expiry to avoid assignment blocks.')}}

error_handler.note: Alert delivery is important but should not block the compliance sweep

modules.name: Error Handler
modules.description: Route errors to Scenario E (DLQ) for investigation.

operations_estimate.notes: Low operation count. Runs once daily. Operations scale with number of active contractors (one update + optional alert per contractor).
